description: Base offering lookup by haircut type, length or stylist. Use compare_options for a supported service with budget, extras or date; preserve any unsupported stylist/length/time requirements for merchant confirmation. Find haircut offerings (and optionally stylists and candidate start times) that satisfy ALL given constraints, across profiled salons (hand-normalized menus) and listed salons (type and inclusions inferred from the service name; offering.comparable says whether it can be compared apples-to-apples). Start times are candidate start times from the salon's published staff schedule; existing bookings are not subtracted, so some may already be taken — confirm on the booking page (slotBasis "schedule_candidates", bookingsSubtracted false, availability_basis "schedule_candidates" = UNCONFIRMED). require_availability=true is satisfied only by provider-confirmed availability (the booking provider’s own open times, existing bookings subtracted). No salon on this site has provider-confirmed availability today: profiled salons have candidate start times from the published staff schedule (existing bookings not subtracted, so they may already be taken) and listed salons have published opening hours only. Offerings with matching candidate start times are listed under `unconfirmed`; confirm on the booking page. Hard constraints are never relaxed silently; when nothing matches, noMatch.reason explains which constraint blocked and nearest suggests the smallest change. Prices are published menu or online-booking prices in USD; this search does not add requested or mandatory extras. Times are salon-local (America/Los_Angeles).
name: search_haircuts
title: Search haircuts by constraints
